description: ILLUSTRATIVE AUDIO PLANNING ONLY. These invented asset durations and encounter contexts are not cooked waveforms, current level state, measured allocations, or an accepted audio budget.

output.note: Proposed 16-bit stereo output: nominal 40 ms blocks. Rate and frames are independent planning inputs; actual AI divider and queued latency require measurement. Eight padding bytes mirror the checked driver request, before 16-byte allocation rounding.

budget.note: Editable 256 KiB thought experiment only; the user has not accepted this envelope and it does not imply remaining whole-machine memory is free.

buffer_pool.note: Manual persistent provisioning, including idle/warmed allocations. Not a claim that libdragon allocates this exact pool. Compare the largest scenario requirements, then verify per-slot high-water sizes and allocator behavior on target.

unmeasured_items: Exact linked audio code, stacks, static mixer state, file handles and pointer tables
Actual codec working state, lookahead, retained sample overlap and slot allocation high-water marks
Custom room effect implementation and final delay/scratch requirements
Allocator metadata, fragmentation and target-rate-dependent buffer changes
Audio share of RSPQ buffers already shared with graphics must be reconciled in the whole-machine ledger
allowances.note: All allowances are manual placeholders, not measured sizes. Shared graphics/RSPQ storage must be assigned once in the whole-machine budget. Unknown allowance and reserve remain separate from enumerated allocations.

assets.label: Example stone footstep bank
assets.note: Invented 1.5-second bank; no recordings exist. Container/shared/decoder sizes are manual conservative placeholders, not a measured WAV64 layout.

assets.label: Example wooden footstep bank
assets.note: Invented alternate material bank retained during the example doorway transition.

assets.label: Example dry guard utterance
assets.note: Invented four-second line. Distinct simultaneous speakers share encoded catalogue data but need independent playback windows/state.

assets.label: Example muffled guard variant
assets.note: Hypothetical synchronized variant for crossfade accounting only; synchronization/seeking still needs implementation.

assets.label: Example stereo ambient bed
assets.note: Invented 30-second stereo loop; two mixer slots, one interleaved per-playback window.

assets.label: Example resident interaction cue
assets.note: Invented quarter-second PCM cue. Resident source data does not remove the SDK's per-playback mixer buffer.

voices.label: Player stone steps
voices.note: Explicit planning window and playback cap; allocation is not inferred from the 22050 Hz source alone.

voices.note: Independent playback of the same asset; count another decoded window.

voices.note: Additional variant voice; not one free filter parameter.

voices.note: Distinct simultaneous playback; no window deduplication by asset.

contexts.label: Planning: quiet corridor
contexts.note: Hypothetical encounter; not current runtime level state. Persistent decoded and decoder pools remain allocated even with few voices.

contexts.label: Planning: doorway crossfade

contexts.label: Planning: pursuit
contexts.note: Hypothetical multiple-emitter stress case with shared source banks.

transitions.label: Planning: corridor to doorway overlap
transitions.note: Union keeps both banks and deduplicates continuous voice/effect IDs. Extra is manual transition/prefetch allowance.

transitions.label: Planning: doorway to pursuit overlap
transitions.note: Both room tails and both material banks overlap. Shared persistent pools, reserves and runtime allowances count once.
